tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Build a weekly status, project update, or quarterly report from a connected source. Native PowerPoint objects. Requires API key.

source.description: jira | github | notion | asana | linear | clickup | csv (pass the file contents in `csv`; spreadsheets: export as CSV)

csv.description: CSV text when source is csv: header row, first column = period/label, other columns numeric

title.description: Deck title when source is csv

tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: List live OAuth / file-import connectors this account can use.

tools.name: populate_template
tools.description: Fill a previously uploaded locked PowerPoint template from a connected source or a CSV / spreadsheet export. Masters stay. Charts stay charts. CSV fills are grounding-checked: every figure comes from the data.

source.description: jira | github | notion | asana | linear | clickup | csv (pass the file contents in `csv`; name charts csv_<column>; tokens like {{revenue_latest}}, {{revenue_change}}, {{label_1}}, {{revenue_1}})

csv.description: CSV text when source is csv: header row, first column = period/label, other columns numeric

title.description: Report title when source is csv; fills {{title}}
